_rule: Round 10's objective record, decision 0018 section 6: per term of dev/audit/config/objective.json either a `value` with the `enumerator`, a command on a tracked script, that printed it, or `no_read` with `would_read` and `builder`. A `by_hand` or `beside` block is no value: it is a figure 0018 sets beside a term or reads by hand, carried for the evaluator to re-read and never graded as the term. Written after the close (the close wrote none), by a record seat for the round-11 orchestrator under tvofi's ruling on card E11-N-OBJECTIVE-RECORD; every command was run by that seat at the shas named here.

window.why: 0018 section 2: the window of round N runs from the previous closeout stamp to its own (decision 0016). Round 9 closed at v7.0.0 (its stamp subject reads `v7.0.0: stamp Round-9 closure`) and round 10 at v10.0.0. Counts by merge use the 1139 first-parent merges of v7.0.0..v10.0.0 (1210 first-parent commits, 71 of them not merges).
